schema.name: Agent Skills
schema.description: Ontology for uploaded agent skill documents.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Short explanation copied or summarized from the skill document.

concepts.name: Skill
concepts.description: A reusable agent skill described by a SKILL.md file.

concepts.name: Tool
concepts.description: A command, API, or local tool the skill exposes or uses.

concepts.name: Capability
concepts.description: A feature or behavior the skill enables.

relationships.name: Provides tool
relationships.description: The skill provides or instructs use of a tool.

relationships.name: Provides capability
relationships.description: The skill enables a capability or feature.

relationships.name: Depends on
relationships.description: The skill depends on another skill.
